module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverScratchDefinitions
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedRoundsDefinitions
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdgeDefinitions
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseOrderedMinimumDefinitions
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParser

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeast
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge GorbowPRProgram
open InternalAcceptance (branch constantZero)
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParser (parser)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverScratch (scratchVertices)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedRounds (members)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdge (edge4)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOrderedMinimum (scratchMinimum)

/-- Test the actual original sparse parser Option on slot 0. A valid
empty context has a successor tag; do not test its nil scratch payload. -/
def contextOption : Program 3 :=
  .composition parser (fun _ : Fin 1 => .projection 0)

/-- The actual same cover C on the original seed at slot 2. -/
def poolAtSeed (C : Program 3) (s : Settings) : Program 3 :=
  .composition (scratchVertices C s) (fun _ : Fin 1 => .projection 2)

/-- Original supplied vertices, original packed ctx, requested type, and
seed, on the same physical length-fuel member calculation with edge4 X W. -/
def membersAtSeed (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (s : Settings) : Program 3 :=
  .composition (members (edge4 X W)) ![poolAtSeed C s,.projection 0,.projection 1,.projection 2]

def minimumAtMembers (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (s : Settings) : Program 3 :=
  .composition scratchMinimum (fun _ : Fin 1 => membersAtSeed C X W s)

/-- The original packed least interface, on [ctx,ty,seed]. The parser
only selects its actual Option branch; the same unchanged packed ctx
is still passed to the same physical endpoint-guarded directed edge. -/
def packedLeastProgram (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (s : Settings) : Program 3 :=
  branch contextOption (constantZero 3) (minimumAtMembers C X W s)

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeast

module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipDefinitions
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseOrderedMinimumTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram List.Vector
open NumberedMultisetNumeric (decodeNumbers)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (z suc unary)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOrderedMinimum (scratchMinimum)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembership (scratchMember)

/-- Exact original ordered scratch decoding and membership for every
numeric input. Failed decoding and an empty pool both reject; a zero
candidate succeeds only at an actual occurrence of zero. -/
def ExactAllInputScratchMembership : Prop :=
  ∀ code candidate : Nat,
    evaluate scratchMember (code ::ᵥ candidate ::ᵥ nil) =
      ((decodeNumbers code).any (fun pool => pool.any (fun head => head == candidate))).toNat

def memberGraph {α : Type} (code candidate : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  programGraph scratchMember (suc z) ![code,candidate]

/-- The same symbolic code/tape and selected candidate on both sides.
No externally decoded pool or numerical correctness is a premise. -/
def selectedOccurs {α : Type} (code selected : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  (unary scratchMinimum (suc selected) code).imp (memberGraph code selected)

/-- Exact arbitrary-open internal occurrence, not an external membership
proof reflected into the calculus, and not an index/first-hit claim. -/
def ExactOpenScratchMinimumOccurs : Prop :=
  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (code selected : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (selectedOccurs code selected))

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets

module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.SourceComputabilityFormulaSupportProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawMinimumOccurrence
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open SourceComputabilityFormulaSupportProof (existsOne)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParserTargets (parserGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (suc unary)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOrderedMinimum (orderedPoolMinimum scratchMinimum)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets (memberGraph)

/-- The exact unchanged executable on the original sparse raw input. -/
def rawMinimumGraph {α : Type} (raw selected : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  unary orderedPoolMinimum (suc selected) raw

/-- One physical parser output supplies the same decoded scratch term
to the real minimum graph and the real occurrence checker. -/
def parsedOccurrenceRow {α : Type} (raw scratch selected : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  parserGraph (suc scratch) raw ⊓
    (unary scratchMinimum (suc selected) scratch ⊓ memberGraph scratch selected)

def parsedOccurrence {α : Type} (raw selected : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  let j : α → α ⊕ Fin 1 := Sum.inl
  existsOne (parsedOccurrenceRow (raw.relabel j) (.var (.inr 0)) (selected.relabel j))

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawMinimumOccurrence

import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalLessThanSupportProof

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawMinimumOccurrenceOpenBranchesProof
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof (compositionValue valueUnique)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptance (constantZero)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceBranchProof (zeroBranchElim successorBranchElim)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceSupportProof (compositionRecover)
open ID1Completion.InternalEqualityTest (predecessor)
open ID1Completion.InternalEqualityTestPredecessorProof (predecessorSuccessor)
open ID1Completion.InternalLessThanSupportProof (zeroConstantValue)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSupportProof (sucNeZeroApply)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (suc z unary)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParser (parser)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParserTargets (parserGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOrderedMinimum
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipOpenChecks (exact_OpenScratchMinimumOccurs)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawMinimumOccurrence

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}

/-- The actual zero parser branch is the actual constant-zero minimum.
It cannot coexist with the observed successor output at this raw tape. -/
theorem reject (raw selected : OTerm α)
    (missing : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (parserGraph z raw)))
    (accepted : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (rawMinimumGraph raw selected))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (parsedOccurrence raw selected)) := by
  have lost := zeroBranchElim parser (constantZero 1) parsedMinimum (suc selected)
    (![raw] : Fin 1 → OTerm α) missing accepted
  obtain ⟨impossible⟩ := valueUnique (constantZero 1) (suc selected) z
    (![raw] : Fin 1 → OTerm α) lost (zeroConstantValue ![raw])
  exact ⟨Derivation.explosion (sucNeZeroApply impossible)⟩

private theorem sameDecoded (raw scratch : OTerm α)
    (known : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (parserGraph (suc scratch) raw))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary decodedScratch scratch raw)) := by
  apply compositionValue predecessor (fun _ : Fin 1 => parser) scratch
    (![raw] : Fin 1 → OTerm α) (![suc scratch] : Fin 1 → OTerm α)
    (predecessorSuccessor scratch)
  intro i
  obtain rfl := Fin.eq_zero i
  exact known

/-- The observed parser successor gives exactly its own predecessor as
scratch input to the real selected minimum; no numerical decode is read. -/
theorem present (raw scratch selected : OTerm α)
    (known : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (parserGraph (suc scratch) raw)))
    (accepted : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (rawMinimumGraph raw selected))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (parsedOccurrenceRow raw scratch selected)) := by
  have selectedBranch := successorBranchElim parser (constantZero 1) parsedMinimum
    (suc selected) scratch (![raw] : Fin 1 → OTerm α) known accepted
  have actual : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary scratchMinimum (suc selected) scratch)) := by
    apply compositionRecover scratchMinimum (fun _ : Fin 1 => decodedScratch) (suc selected)
      (![raw] : Fin 1 → OTerm α) (![scratch] : Fin 1 → OTerm α) selectedBranch
    intro i
    obtain rfl := Fin.eq_zero i
    exact sameDecoded raw scratch known
  obtain ⟨ofMin⟩ := exact_OpenScratchMinimumOccurs body α Γ scratch selected
  obtain ⟨min⟩ := actual
  obtain ⟨parsed⟩ := known
  exact ⟨Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction parsed
    (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction min (Derivation.implicationElimination ofMin min))⟩

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawMinimumOccurrenceOpenBranchesProof

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

abbrev binder {α : Type} (raw selected : OTerm α) : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1) :=
  parsedOccurrenceRow (raw.relabel Sum.inl) (.var (.inr 0)) (selected.relabel Sum.inl)

theorem occurrenceUnfold {α : Type} (raw selected : OTerm α) :
    parsedOccurrence raw selected = existsOne (binder raw selected) := rfl

theorem rawMinimumRename {α β : Type} (raw selected : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (rawMinimumGraph raw selected).relabel j =
      rawMinimumGraph (raw.relabel j) (selected.relabel j) := by
  simp only [rawMinimumGraph,unaryRename,sucRelabel]

private theorem rowRename {α β : Type} (raw scratch selected : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (parsedOccurrenceRow raw scratch selected).relabel j =
      parsedOccurrenceRow (raw.relabel j) (scratch.relabel j) (selected.relabel j) := by
  simp only [parsedOccurrenceRow,conjunctionRename,parserRename,unaryRename,graphRename,sucRelabel]

theorem occurrenceRename {α β : Type} (raw selected : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (parsedOccurrence raw selected).relabel j =
      parsedOccurrence (raw.relabel j) (selected.relabel j) := by
  rw [occurrenceUnfold,occurrenceUnfold,existsRename]
  unfold binder
  rw [rowRename]
  simp only [Term.relabel_relabel] <;> rfl

private theorem memberSubst {α β : Type} (code k : OTerm α) (ts : α → OTerm β) :
    (memberGraph code k).subst (fun a => emb (ts a)) =
      memberGraph (code.subst ts) (k.subst ts) := by
  have tape : (fun i => ((![code,k] : Fin 2 → OTerm α) i).subst ts) =
      ![code.subst ts,k.subst ts] := by
    funext i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · rfl
    · obtain rfl := Fin.eq_zero j
      rfl
  unfold memberGraph
  rw [programSubst,tape,sucSubst,zSubst]

private theorem parserSubst {α β : Type} (out raw : OTerm α) (ts : α → OTerm β) :
    (parserGraph out raw).subst (fun a => emb (ts a)) =
      parserGraph (out.subst ts) (raw.subst ts) :=
  unarySubst parser out raw ts

private theorem rowSubst {α β : Type} (raw scratch selected : OTerm α) (ts : α → OTerm β) :
    (parsedOccurrenceRow raw scratch selected).subst (fun a => emb (ts a)) =
      parsedOccurrenceRow (raw.subst ts) (scratch.subst ts) (selected.subst ts) := by
  simp only [parsedOccurrenceRow,conjunctionSubst,parserSubst,unarySubst,memberSubst,sucSubst]

theorem occurrenceInstance {α : Type} (raw scratch selected : OTerm α) :
    instantiate (binder raw selected) (emb scratch) = parsedOccurrenceRow raw scratch selected := by
  simp only [instantiate,binder,bindEmbedding,rowSubst,liftBind,varBind]

open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)

open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDecodeSyntaxProof (unaryInputsRename)

open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawMinimumOccurrenceTargets

open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawMinimumOccurrenceOpenBranchesProof (reject present)

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (parsedOccurrence raw selected)) := by
  apply optionGraphCases parser (![raw] : Fin 1 → OTerm α) (parsedOccurrence raw selected)

    rw [occurrenceRename]

module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalRawListRecursionDefinitions
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalLessThanDefinitions

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembership
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion
open InternalAcceptance (branch constantZero)
open InternalEqualityTest (equalityTest)
open InternalLessThan (constantOne)
open InternalRawListRecursion (listRec)

/-- Nil always rejects; the candidate is not read as a default head. -/
def memberBase : Program 1 := constantZero 1

/-- The literal row tape is [head, tail membership bit, candidate]. -/
def headMatches : Program 3 :=
  .composition equalityTest ![.projection 0,.projection 2]

/-- On the real head equality return one; otherwise retain the actual
tail result at the same candidate. Nothing changes the original list. -/
def memberStep : Program 3 :=
  branch headMatches (.projection 1) (constantOne 3)

/-- Original arity-two list recursion on [standard scratch code,candidate].
This program is not an unpacker for the separate sparse polynomial codec. -/
def scratchMember : Program 2 :=
  listRec memberBase memberStep

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembership

module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceSupportProof
@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceBranchProof
open FirstOrder Language PositiveArithmeticOperators InternalCalculus InternalGraphComposition InternalControlGraph
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge GorbowPRProgram
open InternalAcceptance InternalAcceptanceSupportProof InternalControlGraphSupportProof InternalControlGraphProof
open InternalGraphCompositionFunctionalityProof
open InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (z suc eqn zRelabel sucRelabel)
open InternalTagArithmeticSupportProof InternalBetaTotalityProof

variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Gamma : List (Formula α)}

theorem branchValue {n : Nat} (control a b : Program n) (out c av bv : OTerm α)
    (xs : Fin n → OTerm α)
    (hc : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph control c xs)))
    (ha : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph a av xs)))
    (hb : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph b bv xs)))
    (ht : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph GorbowPRInternalControl.conditional out
      (Fin.cons c (Fin.cons av (Fin.cons bv Fin.elim0)))))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph (branch control a b) out xs)) := by
  apply compositionValue GorbowPRInternalControl.conditional
    (Fin.cons control (Fin.cons a (Fin.cons b Fin.elim0))) out xs
    (Fin.cons c (Fin.cons av (Fin.cons bv Fin.elim0))) ht
  intro i
  exact Fin.cases hc (Fin.cases ha (Fin.cases hb (fun j => Fin.elim0 j))) i

theorem zeroBranchIntro {n : Nat} (control a b : Program n) (out : OTerm α)
    (xs : Fin n → OTerm α)
    (hc : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph control z xs)))
    (ha : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph a out xs))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph (branch control a b) out xs)) := by
  apply programCases b xs _
  intro β j Delta v hj hv
  simp only [programRename]
  have hc' := renameInto hc j Delta hj
  have ha' := renameInto ha j Delta hj
  simp only [programRename,zRelabel] at hc' ha'
  exact branchValue control a b (out.relabel j) z (out.relabel j) v
    (fun i => (xs i).relabel j) hc' ha' hv
    (conditionalAtZero z (out.relabel j) v ⟨refl z⟩)

theorem zeroBranchElim {n : Nat} (control a b : Program n) (out : OTerm α)
    (xs : Fin n → OTerm α)
    (hc : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph control z xs)))
    (hw : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph (branch control a b) out xs))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph a out xs)) := by
  apply programCompositionCases GorbowPRInternalControl.conditional
    (Fin.cons control (Fin.cons a (Fin.cons b Fin.elim0))) out xs _ hw
  intro β j ys Delta hj ht hg
  simp only [programRename]
  have hc' := renameInto hc j Delta hj
  simp only [programRename,zRelabel] at hc'
  have he := valueUnique control (ys 0) z (fun i => (xs i).relabel j) (hg 0) hc'
  have hs := conditionalAtZero (ys 0) (ys 1) (ys 2) he
  rw [threeTuple] at hs
  obtain ⟨heq⟩ := valueUnique GorbowPRInternalControl.conditional (out.relabel j) (ys 1) ys ht hs
  exact outputTransport a (ys 1) (out.relabel j) (fun i => (xs i).relabel j) ⟨symm heq⟩ (hg 1)

theorem successorBranchIntro {n : Nat} (control a b : Program n) (out k : OTerm α)
    (xs : Fin n → OTerm α)
    (hc : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph control (suc k) xs)))
    (hb : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph b out xs))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph (branch control a b) out xs)) := by
  apply programCases a xs _
  intro β j Delta v hj hv
  simp only [programRename]
  have hc' := renameInto hc j Delta hj
  have hb' := renameInto hb j Delta hj
  simp only [programRename,sucRelabel] at hc' hb'
  exact branchValue control a b (out.relabel j) (suc (k.relabel j)) v (out.relabel j)
    (fun i => (xs i).relabel j) hc' hv hb'
    (conditionalAtNonzero (suc (k.relabel j)) v (out.relabel j) ⟨sucNeZero _⟩)

theorem successorBranchElim {n : Nat} (control a b : Program n) (out k : OTerm α)
    (xs : Fin n → OTerm α)
    (hc : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph control (suc k) xs)))
    (hw : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph (branch control a b) out xs))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph b out xs)) := by
  apply programCompositionCases GorbowPRInternalControl.conditional
    (Fin.cons control (Fin.cons a (Fin.cons b Fin.elim0))) out xs _ hw
  intro β j ys Delta hj ht hg
  simp only [programRename]
  have hc' := renameInto hc j Delta hj
  simp only [programRename,sucRelabel] at hc'

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceSupportProof
open FirstOrder Language PositiveArithmeticOperators InternalCalculus InternalGraphComposition InternalControlGraph
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge GorbowPRProgram
open InternalControlGraphSupportProof InternalRecursionClosureProof InternalRecursionClosureLogicProof
open InternalGraphCompositionFunctionalityProof InternalPositiveUnfoldingSupportProof

variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Gamma : List (Formula α)}

/-- Original Program totality eliminates an object-language witness, never a semantic value. -/
theorem programCases {n : Nat} (p : Program n) (xs : Fin n → OTerm α) (psi : Formula α)
    (k : ∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Delta : List (Formula β)) (v : OTerm β),
      (∀ r ∈ Gamma, r.relabel j ∈ Delta) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (programGraph p v (fun i => (xs i).relabel j))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (psi.relabel j))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma psi) := by
  obtain ⟨ht⟩ := (actualOriginalPrograms body n p).1 α xs
  exact graphExistsCases Gamma _ xs psi ⟨weakenClosed ht Gamma⟩ k

theorem programCompositionCases {m n : Nat} (f : Program n) (g : Fin n → Program m)
    (out : OTerm α) (xs : Fin m → OTerm α) (psi : Formula α)
    (d : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph (.composition f g) out xs)))
    (h : ∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (ys : Fin n → OTerm β) (Delta : List (Formula β)),
      (∀ r ∈ Gamma, r.relabel j ∈ Delta) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (programGraph f (out.relabel j) ys)) →
      (∀ i, Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (programGraph (g i) (ys i)
        (fun a => (xs a).relabel j)))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (psi.relabel j))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma psi) :=
  compositionCases Gamma _ _ out xs psi d h

/-- Recover the outer graph at known component outputs; all witnesses are internal. -/
theorem compositionRecover {m n : Nat} (f : Program n) (g : Fin n → Program m)
    (out : OTerm α) (xs : Fin m → OTerm α) (ys : Fin n → OTerm α)
    (hw : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph (.composition f g) out xs)))
    (hg : ∀ i, Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph (g i) (ys i) xs))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph f out ys)) := by
  apply programCases f ys _
  intro β j Delta v hj hv
  simp only [programRename]
  have hw' := renameInto hw j Delta hj
  simp only [programRename] at hw'
  have hg' (i : Fin n) := renameInto (hg i) j Delta hj
  simp only [programRename] at hg'
  have hs := compositionValue f g v (fun i => (xs i).relabel j)
    (fun i => (ys i).relabel j) hv hg'
  obtain ⟨he⟩ := valueUnique (.composition f g) (out.relabel j) v
    (fun i => (xs i).relabel j) hw' hs
  exact outputTransport f v (out.relabel j) (fun i => (ys i).relabel j)
    ⟨InternalTagArithmeticSupportProof.symm he⟩ hv

theorem oneTuple {X : Type} (ys : Fin 1 → X) : Fin.cons (ys 0) Fin.elim0 = ys := by
  funext i
  obtain rfl := Fin.eq_zero i
  rfl

theorem threeTuple {X : Type} (ys : Fin 3 → X) :
    Fin.cons (ys 0) (Fin.cons (ys 1) (Fin.cons (ys 2) Fin.elim0)) = ys := by
  funext i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
  · rfl
  · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i
    · rfl
    · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) i
      rfl

end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceSupportProof

module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeSyntaxProof
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceSupportProof
@[expose] public section

namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeProof
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators SourceComputabilityFormulaSupportProof
open ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof (programRename outputTransport valueUnique zeroSuccessorCases equalEqn)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceSupportProof (programCases)
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphCompositionFunctionalityProof (renameInto)
open ID1Completion.InternalPositiveUnfoldingSupportProof (formulaRelabelComposition)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (emb z suc)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSupportProof (zeroNeSuc cancelSuc)
open ID1Completion.InternalBetaTotalityProof (addHyp)
open ID1Completion.InternalQuotientComparisonProof (orLeft orRight)
open NumberedWindowInternalProbeTargets (OTerm freshAt)
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeTargets
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeSyntaxProof
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram

variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}

/-- Case analysis on the actual output of any original Program. In the
successor branch the predecessor is a real object eigenvariable. -/
theorem optionGraphCases {n : Nat} (p : Program n) (xs : Fin n → OTerm α) (ψ : Formula α)
    (missing : ∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)),
      (∀ f ∈ Γ, f.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (programGraph p z (fun i => (xs i).relabel j))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (ψ.relabel j)))
    (present : ∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (u : OTerm β),
      (∀ f ∈ Γ, f.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (programGraph p (suc u) (fun i => (xs i).relabel j))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (ψ.relabel j))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ψ) := by
  apply programCases p xs ψ
  intro β j Δ r hj hr
  apply zeroSuccessorCases Δ r (ψ.relabel j)
  · obtain ⟨dr⟩ := hr
    have h0 := outputTransport p r z (fun i => (xs i).relabel j)
      ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩ ⟨addHyp dr _⟩
    exact missing β j _ (fun f hf => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (hj f hf)) h0
  · intro γ k Θ u hk he
    have ht := renameInto hr k Θ hk
    rw [programRename] at ht
    have hsucc := outputTransport p (r.relabel k) (suc u)
      (fun i => ((xs i).relabel j).relabel k) he ht
    simp only [Term.relabel_relabel] at hsucc
    rw [formulaRelabelComposition]
    apply present γ (k ∘ j) Θ u _ hsucc
    intro f hf
    simpa only [formulaRelabelComposition] using hk (f.relabel j) (hj f hf)

theorem outputCases : FreshProbeOutputCases := by
  intro body a α Γ q
  apply optionGraphCases a ![q] (rejectedAt a q ⊔ chosenAt a q)
  · intro β j Δ _ hz
    rw [splitRename]
    rw [unaryRename] at hz
    obtain ⟨h⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨orLeft h⟩
  · intro β j Δ u _ hs
    rw [splitRename]
    rw [unaryRename] at hs
    obtain ⟨h⟩ := hs
    apply Nonempty.intro
    apply orRight
    unfold chosenAt
    apply Derivation.existentialIntroduction (emb u)
    rw [freshInstantiate]
    exact h

theorem rejectedExcludes : FreshProbeRejectedExcludes := by
  intro body a α Γ q u
  have hz : Derivation body (freshAt a q u :: rejectedAt a q :: Γ) (rejectedAt a q) :=
    Derivation.hypothesis (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self)
  have hs : Derivation body (freshAt a q u :: rejectedAt a q :: Γ) (freshAt a q u) :=
    Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self
  obtain ⟨he⟩ := valueUnique a z (suc u) ![q] ⟨hz⟩ ⟨hs⟩
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction (Derivation.implicationIntroduction (zeroNeSuc he))⟩

theorem unique : FreshProbeUnique := by
  intro body a α Γ q u v
  let A := freshAt a q u ⊓ freshAt a q v
  have h : Derivation body (A :: Γ) A := Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self
  obtain ⟨he⟩ := valueUnique a (suc u) (suc v) ![q]
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft h⟩ ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight h⟩
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction (by simpa only [equalEqn] using cancelSuc he)⟩

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeProof

  exact ⟨refl _⟩

theorem projectionValue {n : Nat} (i : Fin n) (xs : Fin n → OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph (.projection i) (xs i) xs)) := by
  unfold programGraph
  rw [actualInitialGraphInstances.2.2,onEquality]
  exact ⟨refl _⟩

theorem compositionValue {m n : Nat} (f : Program n) (g : Fin n → Program m)
    (out : OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α) (xs : Fin m → OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α)
    (ys : Fin n → OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α)
    (hf : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph f out ys)))
    (hg : ∀ i, Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph (g i) (ys i) xs))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph (.composition f g) out xs)) :=
  actualOriginalCompositionIntroduction body m n α Gamma _ _ out xs ys hf hg

theorem recursionZeroValue {n : Nat} (f : Program n) (g : Program (n+2))
    (out : OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α) (xs : Fin n → OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α)
    (hf : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph f out xs))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph (.recursion f g) out (Fin.cons z xs))) :=
  closedApply (actualOriginalRecursionZeroIntroduction body n α _ _ out xs) hf

/-- Previous-result existence is supplied by the proved original Program
closure. The successor step is still the literal source AST graph. -/
theorem recursionSuccessorValue {n : Nat} (f : Program n) (g : Program (n+2))
    (out t : OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α) (xs : Fin n → OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α)
    (hg : ∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Delta : List (Formula β)) (v : OrdinaryArithmetic.Term β),
      (∀ p ∈ Gamma, p.relabel j ∈ Delta) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (programGraph g (out.relabel j)
        (Fin.cons (t.relabel j) (Fin.cons v (fun i => (xs i).relabel j)))))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph (.recursion f g) out (Fin.cons (suc t) xs))) := by
  obtain ⟨ht⟩ := (actualOriginalPrograms body (n+1) (.recursion f g)).1 α (Fin.cons t xs)
  apply graphExistsCases Gamma (OrdinaryArithmetic.graphFormula (.recursion f g))
    (Fin.cons t xs) _ ⟨weakenClosed ht Gamma⟩
  intro β j Delta v hj hv
  simp only [programRename,consTermRename,sucRelabel]
  have hv' : Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (recursion
      (OrdinaryArithmetic.graphFormula f) (OrdinaryArithmetic.graphFormula g) v
      (t.relabel j) (fun i => (xs i).relabel j))) := by
    simpa only [consTermRename,OrdinaryArithmetic.graphFormula,InternalRecursionGraph.recursion] using hv
  exact recursionSuccessorIntroduction Delta _ _ (out.relabel j) (t.relabel j) v
    (fun i => (xs i).relabel j) hv' (hg β j Delta v hj)

theorem outputTransport {n : Nat} (p : Program n) (out other : OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α)
    (xs : Fin n → OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α)
    (he : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (eqn out other)))
    (hp : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph p out xs))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph p other xs)) :=
  graphOutputTransport Gamma _ out other xs he hp

theorem headTransport {n : Nat} (p : Program (n+1))
    (out s t : OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α) (xs : Fin n → OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α)
    (he : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (eqn s t)))
    (hp : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph p out (Fin.cons s xs)))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph p out (Fin.cons t xs))) := by
  apply graphInputTransport body α (n+1) Gamma _ out (Fin.cons s xs) (Fin.cons t xs) _ hp
  intro i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) i
  · rw [onEquality]
    exact he
  · rw [onEquality]
    exact ⟨refl _⟩

theorem valueUnique {n : Nat} (p : Program n) (out other : OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α)
    (xs : Fin n → OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α)
    (hp : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph p out xs)))
    (hq : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph p other xs))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (eqn out other)) := by
  have h := functionalApply _ (actualOriginalPrograms body n p).2 Gamma out other xs hp hq
  rw [onEquality] at h
  exact h

/-- The already-derived original arithmetic split supplies the arbitrary
predecessor witness; no standard-natural semantic case split is used. -/
theorem zeroSuccessorCases (Gamma : List (Formula α)) (t : OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α) (psi : Formula α)
    (hz : Nonempty (Derivation body (eqn t z :: Gamma) psi))
    (hs : ∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Delta : List (Formula β)) (v : OrdinaryArithmetic.Term β),
      (∀ p ∈ Gamma, p.relabel j ∈ Delta) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (eqn (t.relabel j) (suc v))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (psi.relabel j))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma psi) := by
  obtain ⟨hz⟩ := hz
  have hs' : Nonempty (Derivation body (successorExists t :: Gamma) psi) := by
    apply InternalLinearCombinationZeroRemainderProof.successorCases
      (successorExists t :: Gamma) t psi ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩
    intro β j Delta v hj he
    exact hs β j Delta v (fun p hp => hj p (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hp)) he
  obtain ⟨hs'⟩ := hs'
  exact ⟨disjunctionElimination (zeroOrSuccessor t)
    (Derivation.implicationIntroduction hz) (Derivation.implicationIntroduction hs')⟩

theorem nonzeroValue {n : Nat} (p : Program (n+1))
    (out t : OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α) (xs : Fin n → OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α)
    (hn : Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (eqn t z).not))
    (hs : ∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Delta : List (Formula β)) (v : OrdinaryArithmetic.Term β),
      Nonempty (Derivation body Delta (programGraph p (out.relabel j)
        (Fin.cons (suc v) (fun i => (xs i).relabel j))))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Gamma (programGraph p out (Fin.cons t xs))) := by
  obtain ⟨hn⟩ := hn
  apply zeroSuccessorCases Gamma t _
  · exact ⟨Derivation.explosion (Derivation.implicationElimination
      (addHyp hn _) (Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self))⟩
  · intro β j Delta v _ ⟨he⟩
    simp only [programRename,consTermRename]
    exact headTransport p (out.relabel j) (suc v) (t.relabel j)
      (fun i => (xs i).relabel j) ⟨symm he⟩ (hs β j Delta v)

end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof

public import LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowVerifierNormalizationDefinitions
@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open FirstOrder Language PositiveArithmeticOperators InternalCalculus InternalGraphComposition
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge

/-- The unchanged original arithmetic compiler applied to an existing concrete AST. -/
def programGraph {n : Nat} {α : Type} (p : GorbowPRProgram.Program n)
    (out : OTerm α) (xs : Fin n → OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  graph (OrdinaryArithmetic.graphFormula p) out xs

def equal {α : Type} (s t : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  arithmeticEmbedding.onFormula (s.equal t)

/-- Exact equality-test output, including the rejecting case. -/
def testSpec {α : Type} (out input pivot : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  (equal input pivot ⊓ equal out (OrdinaryArithmetic.succTerm OrdinaryArithmetic.zeroTerm)) ⊔
  ((equal input pivot).not ⊓ equal out OrdinaryArithmetic.zeroTerm)

/-- The original conditional takes control first, then the zero branch, then
its nonzero branch. No implicit normalization or truthiness change is made. -/
def conditionalSpec {α : Type} (out control zeroBranch otherBranch : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  (equal control OrdinaryArithmetic.zeroTerm ⊓ equal out zeroBranch) ⊔
  ((equal control OrdinaryArithmetic.zeroTerm).not ⊓ equal out otherBranch)

end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph

module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalFiniteBlocksDefinitions
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.OrdinaryArithmeticProgramDefinitions
@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition
open FirstOrder Language PositiveArithmeticOperators InternalCalculus SourceComputabilityFormulaSupportProof
abbrev OTerm (α : Type) := OrdinaryArithmetic.Term α
abbrev OFormula (α : Type) := OrdinaryArithmetic.Formula α

def graph {n : Nat} {α : Type} (f : OFormula (Fin (n+1))) (out : OTerm α)
    (xs : Fin n → OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  arithmeticEmbedding.onFormula (OrdinaryArithmetic.applyGraph f out xs)

def matrix {m n : Nat} {α : Type} (f : OFormula (Fin (n+1)))
    (g : Fin n → OFormula (Fin (m+1))) (out : OTerm α) (xs : Fin m → OTerm α) :
    OFormula (α ⊕ Fin n) :=
  OrdinaryArithmetic.applyGraph f (out.relabel Sum.inl) (fun i => .var (.inr i)) ⊓
    OrdinaryArithmetic.andFin (fun i => OrdinaryArithmetic.applyGraph (g i) (.var (.inr i))
      (fun j => (xs j).relabel Sum.inl))

/-- Actual proof trees for every term instance of output existence. This is
an explicit premise, not an assertion that arbitrary graph formulas have it. -/
def Total (body : Positive (Fin 1)) {n : Nat} (f : OFormula (Fin (n+1))) : Prop :=
  ∀ (α : Type) (xs : Fin n → OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body [] (existsOne (graph f (.var (.inr (0 : Fin 1)))
      (fun i => (xs i).relabel Sum.inl))))

/-- Actual proof trees for every term instance of output uniqueness. -/
def Functional (body : Positive (Fin 1)) {n : Nat} (f : OFormula (Fin (n+1))) : Prop :=
  ∀ (α : Type) (out other : OTerm α) (xs : Fin n → OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body [] ((graph f out xs ⊓ graph f other xs).imp
      (arithmeticEmbedding.onFormula (out.equal other))))
end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition

module
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalDerivationRenamingTargets
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalSourceIntroductionSyntaxProof
@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalDerivationRenamingSyntaxProof
open FirstOrder Language PositiveArithmeticOperators PositiveArithmeticTransforms
open PositiveArithmeticPredicateSubstitution PositiveArithmeticSchemas InternalCalculus
open SourceComputabilityFormulaSupportProof InternalBinderTransportSyntaxProof InternalBinderTransportProof
open InternalPositiveUnfoldingSupportProof InternalTermSubstitutionSyntaxProof InternalTermSubstitutionProof
open InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof InternalSourceIntroductionSyntaxProof

theorem equalityRename {L : Language} {α β : Type} (s t : L.Term α) (f : α → β) :
    (s.equal t).relabel f = (s.relabel f).equal (t.relabel f) := by
  simp only [formulaRelabel,rename,Term.equal,Term.bdEqual,BoundedFormula.mapTermRel,Term.relabel_relabel]
  rfl

theorem instantiateRename {α β : Type} (phi : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1)) (t : Term α) (f : α → β) :
    (instantiate phi t).relabel f =
    instantiate (phi.relabel (Sum.map f id)) (t.relabel f) := by
  rw [instantiate,formulaSubstRelabel,instantiate,actualRelabelSubstitution]
  congr 1
  funext a
  cases a <;> rfl

theorem weakenRename {α β : Type} (phi : Formula α) (f : α → β) :
    (weaken phi).relabel (Sum.map f id) = weaken (phi.relabel f) := by
  rw [weaken,formulaRelabelComposition,weaken,formulaRelabelComposition]
  rfl

theorem existsRename {α β : Type} (phi : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1)) (f : α → β) :
    (existsOne phi).relabel f = existsOne (phi.relabel (Sum.map f id)) := by
  change ((allOne phi.not).relabel f).not = _
  rw [actualUniversalRenaming]
  rfl

theorem liftRename {α β : Type} (theta : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1)) (f : α → β) :
    (liftPredicateFormula theta).relabel (Sum.map (Sum.map f id) id) =
      liftPredicateFormula (theta.relabel (Sum.map f id)) := by
  rw [liftPredicateFormula,formulaRelabelComposition,liftPredicateFormula,formulaRelabelComposition]
  congr 1
  funext a
  cases a <;> rfl

theorem positiveRenameComposition {α : Type} (p : Positive α) :
    ∀ (β γ : Type) (f : α → β) (g : β → γ),
    PositiveArithmeticTransforms.relabel g (PositiveArithmeticTransforms.relabel f p) =
      PositiveArithmeticTransforms.relabel (g ∘ f) p := by
  induction p with
  | arithmetic phi =>
    intro β γ f g
    simp only [PositiveArithmeticTransforms.relabel,formulaRelabelComposition]
  | predicate t =>
    intro β γ f g
    simp only [PositiveArithmeticTransforms.relabel,Term.relabel_relabel]
  | conj p q ihp ihq =>
    intro β γ f g
    exact congrArg₂ Positive.conj (ihp β γ f g) (ihq β γ f g)
  | guarded guard p ih =>
    intro β γ f g
    simp only [PositiveArithmeticTransforms.relabel,formulaRelabelComposition]
    exact congrArg (Positive.guarded (guard.relabel (g ∘ f))) (ih β γ f g)
  | @all α p ih =>
    intro β γ f g
    change Positive.all (PositiveArithmeticTransforms.relabel (Sum.map g id)
      (PositiveArithmeticTransforms.relabel (Sum.map f id) p)) = _
    rw [ih]
    congr 2
    funext a
    cases a <;> rfl

theorem parameterBodyRename (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α β : Type) (f : α → β) :
    PositiveArithmeticTransforms.relabel (Sum.map f id) (bodyWithParameters body α) =
      bodyWithParameters body β := by
  rw [bodyWithParameters,positiveRenameComposition]
  rfl

theorem replacementRename {α : Type} (p : Positive α) :
    ∀ (β : Type) (f : α → β) (theta : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1)),
    (substitutePredicate p theta).relabel f =
      substitutePredicate (PositiveArithmeticTransforms.relabel f p) (theta.relabel (Sum.map f id)) := by
  induction p with
  | arithmetic phi =>
    intro β f theta
    exact (arithmeticRename f phi).symm
  | predicate t =>
    intro β f theta
    change (instantiate theta (emb t)).relabel f = instantiate (theta.relabel (Sum.map f id)) (emb (t.relabel f))
    rw [instantiateRename,← onTermRelabel]
  | conj p q ihp ihq =>
    intro β f theta
    change ((substitutePredicate p theta).relabel f) ⊓ ((substitutePredicate q theta).relabel f) = _
    rw [ihp,ihq]
    rfl
  | guarded guard p ih =>
    intro β f theta
    change ((arithmeticEmbedding.onFormula guard).relabel f).imp ((substitutePredicate p theta).relabel f) = _
    rw [← arithmeticRename,ih]
    rfl
  | all p ih =>
    intro β f theta
    change (allOne (substitutePredicate p (liftPredicateFormula theta))).relabel f = _
    rw [actualUniversalRenaming,ih,liftRename]
    rfl

theorem actualPredicateReplacementRenaming : InternalDerivationRenamingTargets.ActualPredicateReplacementRenaming := by
  intro α β f p theta
  exact replacementRename p β f theta

theorem successorRename {α β : Type} (theta : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1)) (f : α → β) :
    (successorInstance theta).relabel (Sum.map f id) =
      successorInstance (theta.relabel (Sum.map f id)) := by
  rw [successorInstance,formulaSubstRelabel,successorInstance,actualRelabelSubstitution]
  congr 1
  funext a
  cases a with
  | inl a => rfl
  | inr i =>
    simp only [Sum.elim_inr,Function.comp_apply,Sum.map_inr,id_eq]
    rw [← onTermRelabel,sucRelabel]
    rfl

theorem actualInductionSchemaRenaming : InternalDerivationRenamingTargets.ActualInductionSchemaRenaming := by
  intro α β f theta
  change (((instantiate theta (emb z)).relabel f) ⊓
    ((allOne (theta.imp (successorInstance theta))).relabel f)).imp
      ((allOne theta).relabel f) = _
  rw [instantiateRename,← onTermRelabel,zRelabel,actualUniversalRenaming,actualUniversalRenaming]
  change ((instantiate (theta.relabel (Sum.map f id)) (emb z)) ⊓
    allOne ((theta.relabel (Sum.map f id)).imp ((successorInstance theta).relabel (Sum.map f id)))).imp
      (allOne (theta.relabel (Sum.map f id))) = _
  rw [successorRename]
  rfl

theorem parameterFormulaRename (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α β : Type) (f : α → β) :
    (bodyWithParameters body α).formula.relabel (Sum.map f id) =
      (bodyWithParameters body β).formula := by
  rw [← actualPositiveRenaming,parameterBodyRename]

theorem predicateObjectRename (α β : Type) (f : α → β) :
    (predicateAtObject (α := α)).relabel (Sum.map f id) = predicateAtObject (α := β) := by
  rw [predicateAtObject,← predicateRename]
  rfl

theorem closureRename (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α β : Type) (f : α → β) :
    (closureSchema (bodyWithParameters body α)).relabel f = closureSchema (bodyWithParameters body β) := by
  rw [closureSchema,actualUniversalRenaming]
  change allOne (((bodyWithParameters body α).formula.relabel (Sum.map f id)).imp
    ((predicateAtObject (α := α)).relabel (Sum.map f id))) = _
  rw [parameterFormulaRename,predicateObjectRename]
  rfl

theorem leastnessRename (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α β : Type) (f : α → β)
    (theta : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1)) :
    (leastnessSchema (bodyWithParameters body α) theta).relabel f =
      leastnessSchema (bodyWithParameters body β) (theta.relabel (Sum.map f id)) := by
  change ((allOne ((substitutePredicate (bodyWithParameters body α) (liftPredicateFormula theta)).imp theta)).relabel f).imp
    ((allOne ((predicateAtObject (α := α)).imp theta)).relabel f) = _
  rw [actualUniversalRenaming,actualUniversalRenaming]
  change (allOne (((substitutePredicate (bodyWithParameters body α) (liftPredicateFormula theta)).relabel (Sum.map f id)).imp
    (theta.relabel (Sum.map f id)))).imp
      (allOne (((predicateAtObject (α := α)).relabel (Sum.map f id)).imp (theta.relabel (Sum.map f id)))) = _
  rw [replacementRename,parameterBodyRename,liftRename,predicateObjectRename]
  rfl

theorem actualFixedPointSchemasRenaming : InternalDerivationRenamingTargets.ActualFixedPointSchemasRenaming := by
  intro body α β f
  exact ⟨closureRename body α β f,leastnessRename body α β f⟩

theorem contextWeakenRename {α β : Type} (Gamma : List (Formula α)) (f : α → β) :
    (Gamma.map weaken).map (fun p => p.relabel (Sum.map f id)) =
      (Gamma.map (fun p => p.relabel f)).map weaken := by
  simp only [List.map_map]
  congr 1
  funext p
  exact weakenRename p f

end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalDerivationRenamingSyntaxProof

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawTickShapeSyntaxProof
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators SourceComputabilityFormulaSupportProof
open ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph

theorem stateRename {α β : Type} (a b : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (stateTerm a b).relabel j = stateTerm (a.relabel j) (b.relabel j) := by
  unfold stateTerm
  rw [rawConsRename,rawConsRename,zRelabel]

theorem rawConsSubst {α β : Type} (x y : OTerm α) (ts : α → OTerm β) :
    (rawCons x y).subst ts = rawCons (x.subst ts) (y.subst ts) := by
  unfold rawCons pairTerm
  simp only [sucSubst,addSubst,mulSubst]

theorem stateSubst {α β : Type} (a b : OTerm α) (ts : α → OTerm β) :
    (stateTerm a b).subst ts = stateTerm (a.subst ts) (b.subst ts) := by
  unfold stateTerm
  rw [rawConsSubst,rawConsSubst,zSubst]

/-- Quantifier-free matrix of `goodState` at explicit witnesses. -/
def shapeCore {α : Type} (o f F : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  eqn o (stateTerm f F) ⊓ (eqn f z ⊔ eqn F z)

theorem goodUnfold {α : Type} (out : OTerm α) :
    goodState out = existsOne (existsOne (shapeCore
      ((out.relabel (Sum.inl : α → α ⊕ Fin 1)).relabel Sum.inl)
      (.var (.inl (.inr 0))) (.var (.inr 0)))) := rfl

theorem coreSubst {α β : Type} (o f F : OTerm α) (ts : α → OTerm β) :
    (shapeCore o f F).subst (fun a => emb (ts a)) =
      shapeCore (o.subst ts) (f.subst ts) (F.subst ts) := by
  change (eqn o (stateTerm f F)).subst (fun a => emb (ts a)) ⊓
    ((eqn f z).subst (fun a => emb (ts a)) ⊔ (eqn F z).subst (fun a => emb (ts a))) = _
  rw [eqnSubst,eqnSubst,eqnSubst,stateSubst,zSubst]
  rfl

theorem coreRename {α β : Type} (o f F : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (shapeCore o f F).relabel j = shapeCore (o.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (F.relabel j) := by
  change (eqn o (stateTerm f F)).relabel j ⊓ ((eqn f z).relabel j ⊔ (eqn F z).relabel j) = _
  rw [eqnRelabel,eqnRelabel,eqnRelabel,stateRename,zRelabel]
  rfl

theorem goodRename {α β : Type} (out : OTerm α) (j : α → β) :
    (goodState out).relabel j = goodState (out.relabel j) := by
  rw [goodUnfold,goodUnfold,existsRename,existsRename,coreRename]
  simp only [Term.relabel_relabel]
  rfl

/-- Introduce both literal quantifiers at explicit witnesses (flag first,
then frame) from an actual scratch equation and an actual zero disjunct. -/
theorem goodIntro {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}
    (out a b : OTerm α)
    (he : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn out (stateTerm a b))))
    (hz : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (eqn a z ⊔ eqn b z))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (goodState out)) := by
  let o' : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 1) := out.relabel Sum.inl
  let a' : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 1) := a.relabel Sum.inl
  let A : Formula ((α ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 1) :=
    shapeCore (o'.relabel Sum.inl) (.var (.inl (.inr 0))) (.var (.inr 0))
  let B : Formula (α ⊕ Fin 1) := shapeCore o' a' (.var (.inr 0))
  have firstSlot :
      (Term.var (.inl (.inr 0)) : OTerm ((α ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 1)).subst
        (liftTerms (bindTerm a)) = a' := rfl
  have lastSlot :
      (Term.var (.inr 0) : OTerm ((α ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 1)).subst (liftTerms (bindTerm a)) =
        (Term.var (.inr 0) : OTerm (α ⊕ Fin 1)) := rfl
  have ho : instantiate (existsOne A) (emb a) = existsOne B := by
    simp only [instantiate,bindEmbedding,existsEmbeddedSubst,A,B,coreSubst,liftTermSubst,
      o',liftBind,firstSlot,lastSlot]
  have hi : instantiate B (emb b) = shapeCore out a b := by
    simp only [instantiate,bindEmbedding,B,o',a',coreSubst,liftBind,varBind]
  obtain ⟨de⟩ := he
  obtain ⟨dz⟩ := hz
  change Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (existsOne (existsOne A)))
  apply Nonempty.intro
  apply Derivation.existentialIntroduction (emb a)
  rw [ho]
  apply Derivation.existentialIntroduction (emb b)
  rw [hi]
  exact Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction de dz

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawTickShapeSyntaxProof

module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDecode
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowPairAlgorithm
public import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Sqrt

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDecodeTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators SourceComputabilityFormulaSupportProof
open ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram List.Vector
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDecode

def CandidateValues : Prop :=
  ∀ n, let s := Nat.sqrt n
    evaluate leftCandidate (n ::ᵥ nil) = n - s*s ∧
    evaluate rightCandidate (n ::ᵥ nil) = s - (n - s*s)

def GuardValue : Prop :=
  ∀ n, let s := Nat.sqrt n
    evaluate good (n ::ᵥ nil) = if n - s*s ≤ s then 1 else 0

/-- Exact whole optional output, not only the right inverse at image codes.
The source bounded search remains its own literal existing definition. -/
def AllInputDecoder : Prop := ∀ n, chosenDecode n = NumberedWindowPairAlgorithm.decode n

def certifiedOutputs {α : Type} (n x y : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  programGraph good (OrdinaryArithmetic.succTerm OrdinaryArithmetic.zeroTerm) ![n] ⊓
    (programGraph leftCandidate x ![n] ⊓ programGraph rightCandidate y ![n])

/-- Genuine graph recognition for arbitrary free terms in the retained
object calculus; the standard-natural calibration is not a proof rule. -/
def OpenSuccess : Prop :=
  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (n x y : OTerm α),
    let g := programGraph NumberedWindowInternalSparsePair.pair n ![x,y]
    let s := certifiedOutputs n x y
    Nonempty (Derivation body [] ((g.imp s) ⊓ (s.imp g)))

def hasPreimage {α : Type} (n : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  let nn := (n.relabel (Sum.inl : α → α ⊕ Fin 1)).relabel Sum.inl
  let x : OTerm ((α ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 1) := .var (.inl (.inr 0))
  let y : OTerm ((α ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 1) := .var (.inr 0)
  existsOne (existsOne (programGraph NumberedWindowInternalSparsePair.pair nn ![x,y]))

/-- Sparse failures are arithmetic proof obligations rather than impossible
inputs; every rejecting code is shown internally to have no pair preimage. -/
def OpenFailure : Prop :=
  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (n : OTerm α),
    let g := programGraph good OrdinaryArithmetic.zeroTerm ![n]
    let s := (hasPreimage n).not
    Nonempty (Derivation body [] ((g.imp s) ⊓ (s.imp g)))

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDecodeTargets

module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelope

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowFieldAlgorithm (unpackNode)
open NumberedWindowPositivePathAlgorithm (edgeView hopView)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePair (pairTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelope

def AllInputTaggedNode : Prop := ∀ n, selectedNode n = unpackNode n
def AllInputEdgeEnvelope : Prop := ∀ n, selectedEdge n = edgeView n
def AllInputHopEnvelope : Prop := ∀ n, selectedHop n = hopView n

abbrev z {α : Type} : OTerm α := OrdinaryArithmetic.zeroTerm
abbrev suc {α : Type} (x : OTerm α) : OTerm α := OrdinaryArithmetic.succTerm x

/-- Exact ordinary-arithmetic encoding, independent of the guard and
selectors. The empty list is zero, not an arbitrary final cursor. -/
def rawCons {α : Type} (h t : OTerm α) : OTerm α := suc (pairTerm h t)

def edgeCodeTerm {α : Type} (q w r : OTerm α) : OTerm α :=
  rawCons (suc z) (rawCons q (rawCons r (rawCons w z)))

def hopCodeTerm {α : Type} (t q w r : OTerm α) : OTerm α :=
  rawCons (suc (suc z)) (rawCons t (rawCons (edgeCodeTerm q w r) z))

def unary {α : Type} (p : Program 1) (out code : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  programGraph p out ![code]

def edgeCertified {α : Type} (n q w r : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  unary edgeGood (suc z) n ⊓
    (unary edgeSource q n ⊓ (unary edgeWitness w n ⊓ unary edgeTarget r n))

def hopCertified {α : Type} (n t q w r : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  unary hopGood (suc z) n ⊓
    (unary hopTarget t n ⊓
      (unary hopSource q n ⊓ (unary hopWitness w n ⊓ unary hopRawTarget r n)))

def OpenEdgeEnvelope : Prop :=
  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (n q w r : OTerm α),
    let e := equal n (edgeCodeTerm q w r)
    let a := edgeCertified n q w r
    Nonempty (Derivation body [] ((e.imp a) ⊓ (a.imp e)))

def OpenHopEnvelope : Prop :=
  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (n t q w r : OTerm α),
    let e := equal n (hopCodeTerm t q w r)
    let a := hopCertified n t q w r
    Nonempty (Derivation body [] ((e.imp a) ⊓ (a.imp e)))

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptance (constantZero)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (z suc unary)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePositiveOutputTargets (equivalent)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilter (cell passGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedRounds

def roundGraph {α : Type} (E : Program 4) (out fuel vertices ctx ty seed : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  programGraph (rounds E) out (roundsTape fuel vertices ctx ty seed)

/-- Round zero filters the original vertices against the physical singleton seed. -/
def ExactOpenRoundZero : Prop :=
  ∀ (E : Program 4) (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (out vertices ctx ty seed singleton : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((cell singleton seed z).imp
      (equivalent (roundGraph E out z vertices ctx ty seed)
        (passGraph (constantZero 4) out vertices singleton ctx ty))))

/-- Every successor uses both the same vertices and the actual previous output,
including all occurrences, under the original directed edge. -/
def ExactOpenRoundSuccessor : Prop :=
  ∀ (E : Program 4) (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (out fuel vertices ctx ty seed previous : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((roundGraph E previous fuel vertices ctx ty seed).imp
      (equivalent (roundGraph E out (suc fuel) vertices ctx ty seed)
        (passGraph E out vertices previous ctx ty))))

/-- The chosen fuel is the literal scratch length evaluated on the same supplied vertices. -/
def ExactOpenMembersAtLength : Prop :=
  ∀ (E : Program 4) (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (out fuel vertices ctx ty seed : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((unary poolLength fuel vertices).imp
      (equivalent (programGraph (members E) out (membersTape vertices ctx ty seed))
        (roundGraph E out fuel vertices ctx ty seed))))

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseLeastInstallationTargets
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowCopyAlgorithm (Entries)
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeDispatchWindowTargets (ProbeTy ValidWindow)
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeParsedTyped (Inputs chosenA)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseTuple (InstalledTupleAt)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathAdvanceTargets (ActualLeastCalibration)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawTickTargets (ActualRoot ActualFallback)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseTypedRawTargets (ActualRawSyntax ActualPackedWindow)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverScratchTargets (ActualSelectedCoverOutput)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdgeTargets (ActualTermExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseTypedRaw (typedRaw5)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeast (packedLeastProgram)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseApplicationReinstall (frontendInputs)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseApplicationFrontend (applicationCore)

/-- Changing least changes the positive checker and the source body.
All callbacks, the actual four-field open report and source rules are rederived. -/
def ExactReinstallCalibratedLeast : Prop :=
  ∀ (entries : Entries) (s : Settings) (W : List ProbeTy), ValidWindow s W →
    ∀ (i j cv tv : Program 1) (d oldCore : Program 3) (raw : Program 5)
      (oldLeast newLeast : Program 3) (v : Inputs),
      InstalledTupleAt entries s W i j cv tv d oldCore raw oldLeast v →
      ActualLeastCalibration s newLeast →
      InstalledTupleAt entries s W i j cv tv d oldCore raw newLeast v

/-- The same packed window program is used inside the typed raw step and
the directed exchange of the least evaluator. The new application core
also contains the same actual least evaluator. -/
def ExactPhysicalLeastInstalledTuple : Prop :=
  ∃ C : Program 3, ActualSelectedCoverOutput C ∧
    ∀ (entries : Entries) (s : Settings) (W : List ProbeTy), ValidWindow s W →
      ∃ (i j cv tv syntaxProg : Program 1) (X : Program 2)
        (d oldCore oldLeast root other windowProg : Program 3) (v : Inputs),
        ActualRoot (NumberedWindowConcreteCheckers.root entries s) root ∧
        ActualFallback other ∧ ActualRawSyntax syntaxProg ∧ ActualPackedWindow s windowProg ∧
        ActualTermExchange s X ∧
        let raw := typedRaw5 root other windowProg syntaxProg
        let least := packedLeastProgram C X windowProg s
        let updated := frontendInputs i least v
        ActualLeastCalibration s least ∧
        InstalledTupleAt entries s W i j cv tv d oldCore raw oldLeast v ∧
        InstalledTupleAt entries s W i j cv tv d oldCore raw least v ∧
        chosenA updated = chosenA v ∧
        InstalledTupleAt entries s W i j cv tv d (applicationCore least) raw least updated

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseLeastInstallationTargets

module

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedRounds
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge GorbowPRProgram
open InternalAcceptance (constantZero)
open InternalListCodec (consCode)
open InternalRawListRecursion (listRec)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedFilter (pass)

abbrev roundsTape {T : Type} (fuel vertices ctx ty seed : T) : Fin 5 → T :=
  ![fuel,vertices,ctx,ty,seed]

abbrev membersTape {T : Type} (vertices ctx ty seed : T) : Fin 4 → T :=
  ![vertices,ctx,ty,seed]

/-- The literal standard scratch cons of the actual seed onto nil. -/
def singletonSeed : Program 4 :=
  .composition consCode ![.projection 3,constantZero 4]

/-- The zero round filters the same original vertices against just the
actual seed, without inserting it into a pool where it does not occur. -/
def roundBase : Program 4 :=
  .composition (pass (constantZero 4)) ![.projection 0,singletonSeed,.projection 1,.projection 2]

/-- On [counter,seen,vertices,ctx,ty,seed], the original vertices and the
actual preceding round are different slots; context and type are fixed. -/
def roundStep (E : Program 4) : Program 6 :=
  .composition (pass E) ![.projection 2,.projection 1,.projection 3,.projection 4]

def rounds (E : Program 4) : Program 5 :=
  .recursion roundBase (roundStep E)

/-- Count the actual supplied ordered scratch pool, including repeats. -/
def poolLength : Program 1 :=
  listRec (constantZero 0) (.composition .succ (fun _ : Fin 1 => .projection 1))

def selectedFuel : Program 4 :=
  .composition poolLength (fun _ : Fin 1 => .projection 0)

/-- Use the length of the unchanged supplied vertices as the exact fuel. -/
def members (E : Program 4) : Program 4 :=
  .composition (rounds E) ![selectedFuel,.projection 0,.projection 1,.projection 2,.projection 3]

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedRounds

module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParser
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalLessThanDefinitions

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseOrderedMinimum
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion
open InternalAcceptance (constantZero branch)
open InternalEqualityTest (predecessor)
open InternalLessThan (ltTest)
open InternalRawListRecursion (listRec)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseFieldParser (parser)

/-- Actual [head, encoded-tail-min] tape. Success stores successor of
the code, so an actual head of zero is a nonempty successful offer. -/
def offerHead : Program 2 :=
  .composition .succ (fun _ : Fin 1 => .projection (0 : Fin 2))

def preferHead : Program 2 :=
  .composition ltTest ![offerHead,.projection 1]

/-- No prior result selects the original head. Otherwise compare the
actual two successor-encoded values and retain one of them. Equal
values retain the tail result; this never drops the ordered input list. -/
def minimumStep : Program 2 :=
  branch (.projection 1) offerHead (branch preferHead (.projection 1) offerHead)

/-- This recursor works on the standard Nat.pair scratch list, not
directly on sparse polynomial original input cells. It has no parameters. -/
def scratchMinimum : Program 1 :=
  listRec (constantZero 0) minimumStep

def decodedScratch : Program 1 :=
  .composition predecessor (fun _ : Fin 1 => parser)

def parsedMinimum : Program 1 :=
  .composition scratchMinimum (fun _ : Fin 1 => decodedScratch)

/-- The actual sparse parser is the only entrance to the scratch
recursion. Parser failure goes to none, not a substitute scratch list. -/
def orderedPoolMinimum : Program 1 :=
  branch parser (constantZero 1) parsedMinimum

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseOrderedMinimum

20	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverScratchTargets (ActualSelectedCoverOutput)
21	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseTypedRawTargets (ActualPackedWindow)
22	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdge (edge4 packedEdge)
23	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdgeTargets (ActualTermExchange)
24	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdgeNumericProof (calibration)
25	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedRoundsTargets (exactEdgeBit)
26	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOrderedMinimum (scratchMinimum)
27	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOrderedMinimumNumericStepProof (unaryValue)
28	open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeast
29	open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastTargets
30	open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastNumericMinimumProof (allInput)
31	open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastNumericTapeProof (contextValue membersValue)
32	
33	private theorem edgeFiber (s : Settings) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3)
34	    (hX : ActualTermExchange s X) (hW : ActualPackedWindow s W)
35	    (ctx ty : Nat) (g : List Nat) (parsed : unpack ctx = some g) :
36	    exactEdgeBit (edge4 X W) ctx ty = edge s g ty := by
37	  funext w v
38	  unfold exactEdgeBit
39	  rw [calibration s X W hX hW ctx ty w v]
40	  have bit : packedEdge s ctx ty w v = edge s g ty w v := by
41	    rw [packedEdge, parsed] <;> rfl
42	  rw [bit]
43	  cases edge s g ty w v <;> rfl
44	
45	private theorem minimumValue (s : Settings) (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3)
46	    (hC : ActualSelectedCoverOutput C) (ctx ty seed : Nat) :
47	    evaluate (minimumAtMembers C X W s) (ctx ::ᵥ ty ::ᵥ seed ::ᵥ nil) =
48	      encodeState ((NumberedWindowClassAlgorithm.members (exactEdgeBit (edge4 X W) ctx ty)
49	        (vertices s seed) seed).min?) := by
50	  rw [minimumAtMembers, unaryValue, membersValue C X W hC s ctx ty seed, allInput, numbersRoundTrip] <;> rfl
51	
52	theorem composition : ExactPackedLeastComposition := by
53	  intro s C X W hC hX hW ctx ty seed
54	  unfold packedLeast
55	  rw [packedLeastProgram, evalBranch, contextValue]
56	  cases parsed : unpack ctx with
57	  | none => rfl
58	  | some g =>
59	    change (if numbersNumber g + 1 = 0 then 0 else
60	      evaluate (minimumAtMembers C X W s) (ctx ::ᵥ ty ::ᵥ seed ::ᵥ nil)) =
61	      encodeState (NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm.least s g ty seed)
62	    rw [if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero (numbersNumber g)), minimumValue s C X W hC ctx ty seed,
63	      edgeFiber s X W hX hW ctx ty g parsed] <;> rfl
64	
65	end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastNumericProof

open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOrderedMinimumNumericStepProof (unaryValue)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeast
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastTargets
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastNumericMinimumProof (allInput)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastNumericTapeProof (contextValue membersValue)

private theorem edgeFiber (s : Settings) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3)
    (hX : ActualTermExchange s X) (hW : ActualPackedWindow s W)
    (ctx ty : Nat) (g : List Nat) (parsed : unpack ctx = some g) :
    exactEdgeBit (edge4 X W) ctx ty = edge s g ty := by
  funext w v
  unfold exactEdgeBit
  rw [calibration s X W hX hW ctx ty w v]
  have bit : packedEdge s ctx ty w v = edge s g ty w v := by
    rw [packedEdge, parsed] <;> rfl
  rw [bit]
  cases edge s g ty w v <;> rfl

private theorem minimumValue (s : Settings) (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3)
    (hC : ActualSelectedCoverOutput C) (ctx ty seed : Nat) :
    evaluate (minimumAtMembers C X W s) (ctx ::ᵥ ty ::ᵥ seed ::ᵥ nil) =
      encodeState ((NumberedWindowClassAlgorithm.members (exactEdgeBit (edge4 X W) ctx ty)
        (vertices s seed) seed).min?) := by
  rw [minimumAtMembers, unaryValue, membersValue C X W hC s ctx ty seed, allInput, numbersRoundTrip] <;> rfl

theorem composition : ExactPackedLeastComposition := by
  intro s C X W hC hX hW ctx ty seed
  unfold packedLeast
  rw [packedLeastProgram, evalBranch, contextValue]
  cases parsed : unpack ctx with
  | none => rfl
  | some g =>
    change (if numbersNumber g + 1 = 0 then 0 else
      evaluate (minimumAtMembers C X W s) (ctx ::ᵥ ty ::ᵥ seed ::ᵥ nil)) =
      encodeState (NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm.least s g ty seed)
    rw [if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero (numbersNumber g)), minimumValue s C X W hC ctx ty seed,
      edgeFiber s X W hX hW ctx ty g parsed] <;> rfl

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastNumericProof

module
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsTargets
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceSupportProof
public import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceConjunctionProof

import LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.InternalRecursionGraphZeroEliminationProof

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsRecursionProof
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalAcceptanceSupportProof (programCases)
open ID1Completion.InternalControlGraphSupportProof
  (programRename recursionZeroValue outputTransport valueUnique)
open ID1Completion.InternalRecursionGraphSuccessorIntroductionProof (recursionSuccessorIntroduction)
open ID1Completion.InternalRecursionGraphStepSyntaxProof (consTermRename)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (zRelabel sucRelabel)
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphCompositionFunctionalityProof (renameInto)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (z suc)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePositiveOutputTargets (equivalent)

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)} {n : Nat}

theorem zeroRead (f : Program n) (g : Program (n+2)) (out : OTerm α) (xs : Fin n → OTerm α)
    (actual : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (.recursion f g) out (Fin.cons z xs)))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph f out xs)) :=
  ID1Completion.InternalRecursionClosureLogicProof.closedApply
    (ID1Completion.InternalRecursionGraphZeroEliminationProof.actualOriginalRecursionZeroElimination
      body n α (OrdinaryArithmetic.graphFormula f) (OrdinaryArithmetic.graphFormula g) out xs) actual

theorem succWrite (f : Program n) (g : Program (n+2)) (out fuel prior : OTerm α)
    (xs : Fin n → OTerm α)
    (before : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (.recursion f g) prior (Fin.cons fuel xs))))
    (step : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph g out (Fin.cons fuel (Fin.cons prior xs))))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (.recursion f g) out (Fin.cons (suc fuel) xs))) :=
  recursionSuccessorIntroduction Γ (OrdinaryArithmetic.graphFormula f) (OrdinaryArithmetic.graphFormula g)
    out fuel prior xs before step

theorem succRead (f : Program n) (g : Program (n+2)) (out fuel prior : OTerm α)
    (xs : Fin n → OTerm α)
    (before : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (.recursion f g) prior (Fin.cons fuel xs))))
    (actual : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (.recursion f g) out (Fin.cons (suc fuel) xs)))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph g out (Fin.cons fuel (Fin.cons prior xs)))) := by
  apply programCases g (Fin.cons fuel (Fin.cons prior xs)) _
  intro β j Δ v keep hv
  simp only [programRename,consTermRename] at hv ⊢
  have earlier := renameInto before j Δ keep
  have later := renameInto actual j Δ keep
  simp only [programRename,consTermRename,sucRelabel] at earlier later
  have proposed := succWrite f g v (fuel.relabel j) (prior.relabel j)
    (fun k => (xs k).relabel j) earlier hv
  exact outputTransport g v (out.relabel j) _ (valueUnique _ _ _ _ proposed later) hv

theorem conditional (known left right : Formula α)
    (forward : ∀ Δ, Nonempty (Derivation body Δ known) → Nonempty (Derivation body Δ left) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ right))
    (backward : ∀ Δ, Nonempty (Derivation body Δ known) → Nonempty (Derivation body Δ right) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ left)) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (known.imp (equivalent left right))) := by
  obtain ⟨a⟩ := forward (left :: known :: Γ)
    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self)⟩
    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩

    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self)⟩
    ⟨Derivation.hypothesis List.mem_cons_self⟩
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationIntroduction (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction
    (Derivation.implicationIntroduction a) (Derivation.implicationIntroduction b))⟩

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsRecursionProof
